name: Lot 412
ownership: 34% partnership — effective exposure ~$80,960 (bought €210,000, converted at ~1.1339 EUR/USD)
sale: Goffs Orby Sale Book 1 2026 (Kildare, Ireland) — consigned by Kildaragh Stud
notes: Australia (GB) is an elite Classic winner (Epsom Derby, Irish Derby, Juddmonte International) by Galileo out of 7-time G1 winner Ouija Board. Currently hot at stud: 2 individual G1 winners in 2025 alone (Lambourn — Epsom/Irish Derby double; Cercene — Coronation Stakes). Stands at Coolmore for a modest €15,000, cheap relative to his output. Dam Cappoquin is a winner herself (not black type); this is her first foal. Female family is exceptional and continuously producing: 2nd dam Tecla (5/6 winners) headlined by Givemethebeatboys (multi-Gr.3, Gr.1-placed); 3rd dam Mahalia (8/13 winners) includes Johnny Barnes (Gr.3 winner, Gr.1-placed, sire), and a branch to Meditate (Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf, G1) plus another to Ectot (2x G1 winner, now a sire). Clean cross (Galileo line onto Oasis Dream-line broodmare sire via Muhaarar). Bid to €210,000 at auction but marked WITHDRAWN on the Goffs board — completed as a private deal afterward at that price.
